newsitem.title: POLAND: GALE-FORCE WINDS KILL AT LEAST SIX IN POLAND.
newsitem.headline: GALE-FORCE WINDS KILL AT LEAST SIX IN POLAND.

text.p: Gale-force winds of 120 kilometres per hour struck several regions of Poland on Friday, felling trees and roofs and killing at least six people, PAP news agency reported on Friday.
The winds, which meteorologists said should abate at nightfall, also sent down power and telephone lines.
An evening news programme said at least seven people had been killed and hundreds sent to hospital, and that a tree had also fallen on a train heading from Germany to Warsaw. None were hurt.
